name: YouTube Music
short_desc: Service: YouTube catalog, optional account library and playback for Music.
description: An unofficial music source for Wizard. Try direct playback at home; cloud Wizards may need an always-on private home relay. No ad-free, unlimited, Premium or account-safety guarantees.
